review_result.summary: The code is well-structured and readable, but there are some areas that need improvement for better performance, security, and maintainability.

issues.description: The canvas dimensions are set twice, once in the HTML and once in the JavaScript. This is unnecessary and can cause confusion.
issues.suggestion: Remove the duplicate code and set the canvas dimensions only once.

issues.description: The speed of the game is decreased by 10% every time the snake eats food. This can cause the game to slow down significantly over time.
issues.suggestion: Consider implementing a more balanced scoring system that doesn't slow down the game as much.

issues.description: The game uses the alert() function to display the game over message. This can be a security risk if the game is played in a production environment.
issues.suggestion: Consider using a more secure way to display the game over message, such as a modal window or a toast notification.

issues.description: The keyboard event listener is not removed when the game is over. This can cause memory leaks and other issues.
issues.suggestion: Consider removing the keyboard event listener when the game is over to prevent memory leaks and other issues.

issues.description: The game does not handle the case where the snake runs into the wall or itself when the game is first started.
issues.suggestion: Consider adding a check to handle this case and prevent the game from crashing or behaving unexpectedly.
